verdict.rationale: Jira's feature page claims company-level visibility into progress as projects advance and coordination of initiatives across teams, which points toward cross-project rollup. These are thin marketing statements: no documented portfolio view, hierarchy, or aggregation mechanism is shown. Missing for 10: a documented single portfolio view that aggregates multiple projects, details of how progress rolls up (e.g., hierarchy or percent-complete), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can roll up progress across multiple projects into a single portfolio view

citations.quote: Get visibility on your company's progress towards top priorities as projects advance
Connect engineering, product, and marketing initiatives to coordinate big launches across every team.
